purpose.statement: Audit and repair every physical Barkpark Task record across every lifecycle and dataset.
purpose.why: The larger goal is a Barkpark task ledger that operators can trust for planning, execution, and historical truth. The concrete problem is that thin criteria, generic rationale, duplicate ownership, stale lifecycle claims, and weak proof make a task look actionable or complete when the record cannot support that conclusion. Continuing the corpus-wide structural census, evidence repair, lifecycle reconciliation, and duplicate review is the correct intervention because those checks evaluate every physical record against the same explicit contract and reopen claims that evidence cannot prove. If omitted, future agents will plan from misleading priorities, repeat already-owned work, and treat false completion as fact.
